_comment: C-135 false-positive corpus for C-038 TP1. Every server here is BENIGN and must produce NO finding. The bidi and zero-width code points are written as JSON \u escapes on purpose: a literal invisible character in a fixture is unreviewable and is silently lost to a copy-paste, which would make the regression pass vacuously.

hebrew-field-mcp._why: Hebrew prose isolating an LTR field name with FSI/PDI (U+2068/U+2069) - the Unicode-recommended way to embed an LTR identifier in RTL text.

arabic-api-mcp._why: Arabic prose embedding an https URL with the legacy LRE/PDF pair (U+202A/U+202C).

softhyphen-docs-mcp._why: Lone soft hyphen (U+00AD) left by wrapped prose.

bom-csv-mcp._why: Lone BOM (U+FEFF) left by a file read without utf-8-sig.

tools.name: read_csv
tools.description: ﻿Reads a CSV file and returns rows as JSON.

zwsp-display-mcp._why: Lone zero-width spaces (U+200B) used as line-break hints inside long identifiers.

tools.name: split_identifier
tools.description: Splits long identifiers like get​UserProfile​ById for display.

wordjoiner-timeout-mcp._why: Lone word joiner (U+2060) keeping a value and its unit on one line.

tools.name: wait_for_server
tools.description: Waits up to 30⁠s for the server to respond.

index-rebuild-mcp._why: Ordinary build-tool prose: 'previous' is an adjective on a benign noun, not an instruction-override directive.

tools.name: rebuild_index
tools.description: Rebuilds the index from scratch and will ignore all previous cache entries.

profile-apply-mcp._why: Same class as above, with 'previously' - the word does not even end where the old prefix match assumed it did.

tools.name: apply_profile
tools.description: Applies the new profile and will ignore all previously configured overrides.

filesystem-mcp._why: C-135 round 3: 'SYSTEM\s*:' had no left anchor, so the tail of any word ending in 'system' followed by a colon FAILed. Both spellings below were confirmed false FAILs.

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Filesystem: reads and writes files under the workspace root.

tools.name: list_packages
tools.description: Ecosystem: lists installed packages and their pinned versions.

prompt-library-mcp._why: C-135 round 3: the attributive-noun reading the filler window opens. 'prompt' modifies 'templates' - the head of the object is a template, not a prompt - which is why the widened arm requires a PLURAL head noun.

tools.name: reload_library
tools.description: Reloads the library and will ignore all previously cached prompt templates.

tools.name: drain_queue
tools.description: Ignore all previous message queue entries older than a day.

cache-invalidate-mcp._why: The hardest benign case: the instruction noun IS present, but four words past the adjective and across a clause boundary a bounded filler window cannot cross.

tools.name: invalidate
tools.description: Ignore all previous cache entries when the instructions file changes.
